notes.title: The Jukebox Update 04/08/24
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Can now toggle between songs in the cafe by clicking on the jukebox.
[*] Added a visual indication to Ace's Vanishing Act and Statue's Re-Energize
[*] Wait For It reworked: "Deals 10 damage. Energy reduced by 1 each time it's discarded without use." -> "Deals 22 damage. Energy reduced by 1 each time it's discarded. Burn."
[*] Turn The Tables description updated: "Deal 9 damage to each enemy planning to attack next turn." -> "Deal 9 damage to each enemy planning to attack."
[*] Updated Ace's lore and pronouns
[*] Koko will no longer ask you for your credit card information.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug when playing Photobomb with Leave It To Me in your hand.
[*] Koko will no longer softlock your game if you skip her dialogue.
[*] Fixed several card description bugs.
[*] The journal no longer shows updated values for cards that change during gameplay.
[*] Damage block now properly prevents damage from Balloon Animal
[/list]
